prior_289_result: Previous query-default candidate validation; not this review execution

pure_absolute_python_path_difference.interpretation: Conservative environment invalidation is observed for this pure check; not proof arbitrary scripts can omit PATH.

unused_java_home_for_python.interpretation: Default environment set spans unrelated toolchains; env_keys only adds keys, cannot narrow.

same_absolute_python_dynamic_child.interpretation: Dropping PATH globally would remove a real causal input even with an absolute top-level interpreter.

unchanged_path_changed_child_bytes.interpretation: PATH value hashing is not nested-toolchain identity. Existing selected external inputs can bind the real child bytes; dynamic read-set completeness is not guaranteed.

repeated_compaction.interpretation: Already compacted record is rewritten and counted cleaned again. This is repeated bookkeeping, not evidence of repeated deletion or corruption.

unfinished_task_lifecycle.interpretation: Retaining an unfinished task is correct; there is no distinct authorized not-delivered terminal lifecycle. Do not fake complete/defer or delete failure to save space.

decisions.environment_binding: Keep conservative inherited environment as default. Explain current mismatch without reconstructing history. Narrow only with an explicitly controlled actually passed environment and selected toolchain inputs; never omit PATH just because argv[0] is absolute.
decisions.repeated_compaction: Confirmed local idempotence/reporting defect: fix actual repeat writes and cleaned count, preserve ownership/handoff/forget guards. Not implemented in this review.
decisions.unfinished_tasks: No explicit non-delivery terminal lifecycle exists. Design a deliberate retire operation with real authority and surviving unresolved knowledge before implementing; never mark complete or delete pending facts to satisfy a quota.
decisions.global_size: Existing total usage and paged stale inspection remain useful; per-task bounds do not cap cumulative storage. No supported need for a new database, permanent index or guessed team-wide quota.

implementation_order: already-tested CLI query fix plus compaction idempotence small fix
environment identity explanation with no relaxed reuse
controlled-environment and explicit retire lifecycle design/approval, then counterexamples before rollout
